content: ACP session/request_permission: agent->client request with sessionId, toolCall (ToolCallUpdate), options[] of PermissionOption {optionId, name, kind: allow_once|allow_always|reject_once|reject_always}; response outcome is {outcome:selected, optionId} or {outcome:cancelled}; cancelled MUST be returned if the prompt turn is cancelled mid-request; clients may auto-approve from user settings; agents should handle timeouts.
